duplicate_rate_definitions.note: The frozen gate uses the mean WITHIN-fixture definition, documented in stage1_metrics.compute_endpoints as the scale-stable unit. The corpus-wide raw rate is reported for transparency and is NOT the preregistered gate unit.

out_of_packet_metric_reference.definition: mechanism names an observable metric that is legal in the global frozen PROVIDER_METRICS vocabulary but has NO evidence cell in that fixture's own frozen evidence packet observable_vocabulary
out_of_packet_metric_reference.interpretation: Grounding is defined by the frozen formalizer over evidence_refs and passed 100%; provider-safety is checked against the global vocabulary. These mechanisms are therefore legitimately F4 under the frozen rules, but a Stage-2 test of them would require provider fields not present in the Stage-1 packet for that fixture. Stage-2 feasibility caveat only.

schema_numeric_claim_guard.note: All recorded validation errors are of class mechanism[i]_numeric_claim_in:<field>. schema.py records the error but still admits the mechanism, so all 595 mechanisms reached formalization by frozen design. Advisory, not exclusionary.
